svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Jaw: cut two 45 mm lengths of 40 x 10 mm steel flat bar; deburr.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill 8.5 mm and tap M10 right through, 13 from one end, on the centre line.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Break the edges; zinc plate or paint with zinc-rich primer.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Packer: cut two lengths of steel tube, 16 mm outside, 10.5 mm or more

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside, 12.2 long: the flange thickness less 0.5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Measure the real flange first and cut to suit; square the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the jaw goes under the flange, 22 mm in from the tip, its tapped

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end out past the tip. The packer stands on the jaw beside the tip.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The M10 x 35 bolt comes down through the foot block tail and the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: packer into the jaw; it must not stand out below the jaw.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the bolt runs into the jaw by hand, and its tip stops

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 mm or more short of the jaw's underside.
